name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Annadoot Yojana
benefit: - **Interest Subsidy/Grant:** A 3% interest subsidy/grant is provided for 7 years.- **CGTMSE Fee Refund:** A maximum refund of the Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises fee of up to ₹1,25,000/- is provided.- **Maximum Vehicle Cost Covered:** The scheme supports the purchase of vehicles with an approximate cost of up to ₹25,00,000/-.- **Payment for Transportation:** Payment fo
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a native resident of the rural or urban local body of the concerned district of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must be aged between 18 and 45 years. - The applicant must have passed the 8th standard in educational qualification. - The applicant must possess a Heavy Motor Vehicle driving license to operate the vehicle. - The applicant must have clearance from the bank for obtaining the loan (defaulter status must be 'No'). - The applicant must not be a Government servant or pensioner. - The applicant must not have annual family income exceeding ₹12,00,000/-. - The applicant must not be involved in any criminal activity or have a criminal background. - The applicant must not be currently benefiting from any other self-employment scheme.
